# nullray

> Terminal coding agent written in Odin. Custom TUI, Landlock/seccomp
> sandbox on Linux, OpenAI-compatible providers, local models. Repo:
> https://github.com/Quad4-Software/nullray

## Docs

- [Home](https://nullray.xyz/docs/): overview and doc map
- [Install](https://nullray.xyz/docs/install/): packages and source build
- [Quick start](https://nullray.xyz/docs/quick-start/): first run
- [Providers](https://nullray.xyz/docs/providers/): keys and models
- [Configuration](https://nullray.xyz/docs/configuration/): env vars
- [Modes and permissions](https://nullray.xyz/docs/modes/): modes, gate
- [TUI](https://nullray.xyz/docs/tui/): interface and binds
- [Slash commands](https://nullray.xyz/docs/commands/): command table
- [CLI reference](https://nullray.xyz/docs/cli/): flags and print mode
- [Sessions](https://nullray.xyz/docs/sessions/): transcripts and usage
- [Sandbox](https://nullray.xyz/docs/sandbox/): Landlock and ops profiles
- [Security](https://nullray.xyz/docs/security/): secrets and trust
- [Skills and MCP](https://nullray.xyz/docs/skills-mcp/): extensibility
- [Subagents](https://nullray.xyz/docs/subagents/): task tool
- [Memory and RAG](https://nullray.xyz/docs/memory-rag/): recall and vectors
- [Troubleshooting](https://nullray.xyz/docs/troubleshooting/): doctor and fixes
